sloka: आदित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते नियमादूर्द्ध्वबाहव: ।एते परे विशालाक्षि मुनय: संशितव्रता: ॥ २.९५.७॥
transliteration: ādityamupatiṣṭhante niyamādūrddhvabāhava: ।ete pare viśālākṣi munaya: saṁśitavratā: ॥ 2.95.7॥

translations.english: O largeeyed Sita, some other ascetics of rigid austerities worship the sungod according to tradition, lifting up their arms and invoking the Sun.
